name: How long does water heater installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does water heater installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard water heater installations, replacing a similar unit in the same location, can be completed within 2 to 4 hours. However, the timeline can vary depending on several factors. If you are upgrading from a traditional tank to a tankless system, or if your new unit requires gas line modifications, electrical upgrades, or new venting, the installation could take longer. Complex installations might require a full day. To provide an accurate estimate, our technicians first assess your current setup and the requirements for your new water heater during a consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard water heater installation typically takes 2 to 4 hours. Factors like upgrading to a tankless system or needing gas/electrical modifications can extend the timeline.
